properties.name: cpf.logging.dynamic-level.enabled
properties.description: Enables the local dynamic log-level registry and trace-boost consumer wiring.

properties.name: cpf.logging.dynamic-level.max-active-rules
properties.description: Maximum number of active local dynamic log-level rules.

properties.name: cpf.logging.dynamic-level.max-audit-records
properties.description: Maximum retained in-memory audit records for dynamic log-level commands; oldest entries are dropped with a counter.

properties.name: cpf.logging.dynamic-level.max-ttl
properties.description: Maximum TTL accepted for one dynamic log-level rule.

properties.name: cpf.logging.file.process-lock-timeout-ms
properties.description: Bounded wait for the OS file lock used by cross-process append, restore and retention operations.

properties.name: cpf.logging.policy-version.in-memory.command-ttl
properties.description: Retention window for log-policy command idempotency records.

properties.name: cpf.logging.policy-version.in-memory.maximum-command-records
properties.description: Maximum retained idempotency command records.

properties.name: cpf.logging.policy-version.in-memory.maximum-history-per-target
properties.description: Maximum retained versions per managed log-policy target.

properties.name: cpf.logging.policy-version.in-memory.maximum-targets
properties.description: Maximum managed target keys in the explicit single-JVM provider.

properties.name: cpf.logging.policy-version.mode
properties.description: Versioned log-policy control-plane mode. in-memory is single-JVM only; shared deployments provide a durable store.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.download-token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Lifetime of a one-time download grant token.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.job-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Maximum lifetime of one bundle job and artifact.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.max-active-jobs
properties.description: Maximum active bundle jobs in one runtime.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.max-artifacts-per-job
properties.description: Maximum distinct artifacts in one bundle job.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.max-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Per-owner bundle submission rate limit.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.max-retained-jobs
properties.description: Maximum retained job metadata before new submissions fail closed.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded in-memory queue for bundle jobs.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.bundle-job.worker-count
properties.description: Bounded worker count for remote-log bundle creation.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.in-memory.command-ttl
properties.description: Retention window for masking policy command idempotency records.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.in-memory.maximum-command-records
properties.description: Maximum retained idempotency command records in the explicit single-JVM provider.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.in-memory.maximum-history
properties.description: Maximum retained masking policy versions in the explicit single-JVM provider.

properties.name: cpf.security.masking-policy.mode
properties.description: Masking policy store mode: disabled, in-memory for single-JVM development, or jdbc for shared durable optimistic control.

properties.name: cpf.security.sensitive-access.in-memory.maximum-grants
properties.description: Maximum retained raw-access approval grants in the explicit single-JVM provider.

properties.name: cpf.security.sensitive-access.in-memory.terminal-retention
properties.description: Retention window for terminal raw-access grants to preserve idempotent replay and prevent request-id reuse.

properties.name: cpf.security.sensitive-access.mode
properties.description: Sensitive raw-access provider mode. Use in-memory only for single-JVM development; shared deployments provide a durable CAS store.

properties.name: cpf.state.in-memory.command-ttl
properties.description: Retention window for in-memory state idempotency command records.

properties.name: cpf.state.in-memory.maximum-operations-per-state
properties.description: Maximum retained idempotency commands per configured state capacity unit.

properties.name: cpf.state.in-memory.maximum-states
properties.description: Maximum state records held by the explicit single-JVM in-memory provider.

properties.name: cpf.state.mode
properties.description: State provider mode. Use in-memory only for single-JVM development; shared deployments must provide a durable CpfStateStore.

properties.name: cpf.tracing.sampling.maximum-override-entries
properties.description: Maximum combined module and business-transaction trace sampling overrides.
